thread:
ellie: Design sprint request for April launch webinar and evergreen post-event funnel. Needs: hero benchmark graphic (wide), 2-step inbound funnel SVG + PNG, three social card templates (static + animated sparkline), a landing thumbnail (copy-first) and an email badge. Deadline: comps by Tue noon PT. Can we scope?

ben: We can take it. Quick clarifiers: hero aspect 1200x628 (og image) or 1600x900? Also, should benchmark compare models on cost_per_1000 vs p95_ms or tokens/sec vs cost?

ellie: Use 1600x900 for hero. Benchmark should be cost_per_1000 on x axis vs p95_ms on y axis; show a lightweight regression line and two labeled clusters: "low-cost" and "low-latency". Keep annotations non-quantitative (per legal).

ben: Noted. Deliverables list I'm tracking:
- hero_bench_1600x900_static.svg/png
- hero_bench_1600x900_og.jpg (optimized)
- funnel_seq_1.svg (registration->qualify->trial)
- funnel_seq_2.svg (post-webinar routing: nurture / sdr)
- social_ig_1080x1080_static + sparkline_gif
- social_x_800x450_static + sparkline_gif
- social_li_1200x627_mp4_fallback
- landing_thumbnail_copy-first_600x800.png
- email_badge_round+pill (3 sizes)

julia: Brand notes: stick to type scale v2, use grayscale background for charts (no gradients). Include footer lockup text: "Redwood Inference — production-ready inference" and a tiny source line: "internal benchmark; illustrative". Add alt text drafts for all assets.

tariq: For metrics, attaching the CSV: https://drive.redwood/bench/2026-q2-inbound.csv. Fields: model,cost_per_1000,p95_ms,tokens_sec. Please read and bin outliers (p95 > 2000ms).

ben: Legal check: we'll avoid explicit dollar claims. Annotations will say "lower-cost" and "lower-latency". Julia, will you do a brand+legal sweep after comps?

julia: Yes. I'll do quick sweep. Also request that color contrast passes AA for text and key annotation strokes.

ellie: Localization: provide APAC copy variants (shorter CTAs). Also provide dark-mode palette for the APAC social variants.

ben: Animation notes: sparkline should be subtle loop 12 frames, under 1.5MB for IG, MP4 under 3MB for LinkedIn. Provide an alt description for the animation and a static fallback. Will export Lottie? No, GIF + MP4 + static PNG.

ops-bot: Reminder: naming convention must match: MIQ_launch2026_{asset}_{channel}_{variant}. Example: MIQ_launch2026_herobench_og_static. Tag final Figma pages with: release/launch-inbound/2026-04-14.

julia: Accessibility: include alt text lines like: "Scatter plot showing tradeoff between cost and p95 latency; clusters labeled lower-cost and lower-latency". Include keyboard-focusable SVG where possible for funnel.

ben: Timeline: static comps by Tue 12:00 PT, animated cards Thu EOD, final exports Fri 10:00 PT. Can we hit that?

ellie: Yes, but I need copy variants and final CSV by EOD today. I'll drop landing thumbnail copy in 45m.

tariq: CSV note: updated metrics posted 09:10 PT (file link above). I removed 3 outliers and normalized cost_per_1000 to USD scale.

ben: Figma file path: /Marketing/2026/launch-inbound/assets. I'll create frames named per ops-bot convention and paste link in thread when ready.

julia: Small ask: include badge PNG with transparent background and an email-safe 600px wide version.

ellie: Also want a 1-column mobile-first landing thumbnail (600x800) that puts copy on left and hero on right — will need a version with short headline (for APAC) and long headline (global).

ops-bot: Automated export will pick up files only if frames are tagged with release/launch-inbound/2026-04-14.

ben: Ok locking scope. I'll post first comps in figma by 11:45 PT. @ellie will you confirm final copy?

ellie: Confirmed. I'll post copy in 30m. Thanks all :sparkles:
